summary: An excerpt from a novel's Book 10, part 97. Lee-Daniel confronts MacDiarmid, co-owner of CogRad, who insists on a face-to-face talk and tells Lee-Daniel that his hands-on field work has run its course, since the company is moving abroad, possibly to Guatemala. The narrative then turns to CogRad's efforts to site repeater arrays on Indian reservations, where the Paiute elders refuse permission at Moapa River and an Akwesasne Warriors leader named Meatloaf briefs the crew on restricted zones.
one_line: In a fiction excerpt, CogRad co-owner MacDiarmid pushes Lee-Daniel out of field operations while Meatloaf briefs surveyors on restricted zones of a reservation.
key_facts: MacDiarmid tells Lee-Daniel that he owns fifteen percent of CogRad, the same as Lee-Daniel.
Lee-Daniel apologizes to MacDiarmid, saying he is sorry if he flew off the handle.
MacDiarmid says Lee-Daniel has been needed for six years as someone at the helm who could handle the dirty work.
MacDiarmid says the company is going abroad and that the next phase needs a delicate touch.
MacDiarmid asks, 'If Canada ends up in a firefight, what'll it be like in Guatemala?'
MacDiarmid says that if Lee-Daniel would take orders from someone else he could be kept on as COO or VP of Research and Development, but no one would ever be able to tell Lee-Daniel what to do.
CogRad's team had to work around surveying constraints at the Moapa River Indian Reservation.
The Moapa site had a burial ground that was ideal for a repeater-array with a commanding view of the Rez.
The Paiute elders at Moapa River refused to let CogRad's surveyor crew hammer in stakes for the repeaters, despite the offer of a share in casino connectivity.
The Akwesasne Warriors gave CogRad a two-hour briefing led by a man in camou fatigues who called himself 'Meatloaf'.
Meatloaf's topo map of the Rez was displayed on the wall of the school auditorium.
Meatloaf said areas marked with post-its are strategic and that no one except a Warrior may go within 20 meters, which Lee-Daniel translated as sixty feet.
The briefing took place in the fading light streaming through steel-reinforced windows.
